description: Publish a file fetched from a public http(s) URL, not a local path (max 5 MiB, video 20 MiB); HTML and Markdown files become pages. Returns the share link, the owner token and manageUrl (private: its holder can edit or delete). Owner tokens and management links never go into published content.

filename.description: Name instead of the URL's; its extension decides page or file

namespace.description: `public` for anything meant to be found or shared: listed in the gallery and sitemap, indexed by Google, Bing and AI search; unsuitable for secrets or personal data. Omit (default): private, a generated priv-* namespace, unlisted; the link still opens it. A custom name: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ownerToken.description: Owner token of an earlier create

ttlDays.description: Days to keep it: up to 30 days without an account, up to 90 with a free profile (an ownerToken held in the profile). Omitted: the default. The result states the expiry.

name: publish_file
title: Publish file from URL
